The black kiteshield has the same defensive bonuses as a [[white kiteshield]], but without the +1 [[Prayer bonus|prayer]] bonus. The black kiteshield can be found in trimmed and heraldic forms from [[Treasure Trails]]. As with all [[black items]], it can not be made with the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -8 |arange = -3 |dstab = +17 |dslash = +19 |dcrush = +18 |dmagic = -1 |drange = +18 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = shield |image = [[File:Black kiteshield equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Black kiteshield equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black kiteshield}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black kiteshield}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black kiteshield}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The shield's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -2 to -3. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 May 2004 |update = Bigger Banks & Treasure Trails |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black kiteshield detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black kiteshield detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black kiteshield (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Black kiteshield.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 –
